notes: `test-fails-without-the-fix` copies the finished workspace, restores src/ to the fixture commit, and requires the suite to fail. That is the only mechanical way to check the skill's rule that a regression test must fail against the unfixed code.
`existing-tests-unchanged` is the pass condition for the refactor task, where adding a test is the wrong answer.
`no-parallel-test-tree` catches a run that invents tests/ or test/ next to an existing layout.
